analysis:
Market regime is confirmed uptrend (SPY +1.8% vs SMA50, 20d slope +1.22%), which is supportive, but our portfolio metrics demand humility: 25% win rate, 0.15x profit factor, and a -2.82 Sortino ratio are sobering. Three WDAY losses in sequence exposed a discipline gap around re-entering a failing thesis — that must not repeat. The core lesson: we are not generating stock-picking alpha, so risk management and selectivity ARE the edge.

EXISTING POSITION REVIEW:
- AMP (+4.15%): Thesis intact — quality financial services compounder. Hold.
- MCO (+9.21%): Best performer. Ratings/analytics business secular tailwind unchanged. Hold.
- ROP (+1.17%): Working, SMA50 slope now +8.4% — momentum accelerating under us. Hold.
- SYK (+0.22%): Flat but thesis (medtech compounding, aging population) intact; in the candidate screen as basing uptrend. Hold.
- IDXX (-0.91%): Small unrealized loss; vet diagnostics recurring revenue thesis unchanged, not at stop. Hold.
- LMT (-2.90%): Defense spending demand remains elevated globally; position is underwater but not at stop. Thesis holds; monitor closely for further deterioration.

NEW TRADE CAPACITY: With 84% deployed and only ~$11,098 headroom, this is NOT a time to add multiple positions. One small, well-reasoned addition is the ceiling. Extended candidates (IT +24% vs SMA50, BR +17%, ACN +18%) are late-cycle entries — hard rule says avoid. ADBE earnings in 14 days — avoid event risk. INTU has -9% EPS revision trend — skip. EXE has -10.6% revenue growth and -7.5% EPS revisions — declining business, skip. TSCO has -11.4% EPS revisions and is -16.5% below SMA200 — skip.

Best remaining setup within budget: KKR. Alt asset management has secular AUM growth tailwinds (pension/insurance rotation to alternatives), PEG of 0.55 and fwd P/E ~14.7 represent genuine value for the growth profile, and the stock is basing at 39% of its 52w range with SMA50 slope accelerating +5.4%. Not extended. Earnings 70 days away. Small position sizing respects budget and keeps portfolio heat within bounds.

trades.entry_strategy: Limit order at $108.50 or better; if market opens above, wait for a 1-3% intraday pullback toward SMA50 before entry. Do not chase above $112.
trades.rationale: FUNDAMENTAL: KKR is a premier alternative asset manager with a PEG of 0.55 and fwd P/E ~14.7 — genuinely cheap for a business growing AUM at a double-digit secular rate driven by pension and insurance capital rotating into private credit, infrastructure, and real assets. Revenue growth of 7.8% with positive EPS revisions (flat to slight positive) in a rising rate environment where alt managers earn higher carried interest and credit spreads. Op margin 20.6% reflects high-quality fee-based earnings. TECHNICAL: Stock is basing at 39% of its 52w range, SMA50 slope at +5.4% (accelerating), and is +7.8% above SMA50 — constructive but not extended. This is Stage 1 to Stage 2 transition territory. ATR of 3.7% supports a clean 1.6x ATR stop (~6% below entry) that fits within the drawdown tolerance rule. Earnings not until Nov 5 (70 days), giving the thesis time to develop without near-term event risk.
trades.exit_plan: Stop loss at $102.00 if hit. Exit if: (1) earnings season reveals AUM outflows or margin compression; (2) price closes below SMA50 on elevated volume after a failed breakout attempt; (3) broader financial sector enters confirmed downtrend. At target $126, reassess — if business momentum and SMA structure remain intact, consider trimming 50% and letting remainder ride toward LTCG threshold. Time stop: reassess thesis at 90 days if price is flat and below $108.
